text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno crosses the finish line in first!
No victory can escape this monster!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh... Seeing her in person, her presence is unreal...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Things get super fun
whenever Golshi's around, though!
Man, I wonder if we'll face off again someday!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: It'll become a reality very soon.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno-san!
How did it feel out there? How was your run in the Nikkei Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It was a fitting departure
to head toward a new beginning. ——...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship-san!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"You're coming to the Spring Tenno Sho too, aren't you?
As a stayer who conquered the Kikuka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see right through your schemes!
You're just trying to rewrite history again for your own amusement!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I will personally put a stop
to all of that nonsense!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: It'll be me beating you at the Tenno Sho (Spring)!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...!
Ooooh...!!
(Uwooooooooooah!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Heh. ...Haha.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!!
Ah...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Yo.

On the way back from the Nikkei Sho,
a familiar Umamusume was standing at the school gates.
choice_data_list: You were waiting for Meno to come home

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gotta answer the summons!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still though, the Spring Tenno Sho, huh...?
To utter that name without Mac-chan's permission...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wash the plate on your hat and wait.
I'm gonna leave you soaking wet.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Brace yourself!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss!?
(*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha!
Got a photo of Mame-chin
being shielded by her Trainer~♪

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wh... Wh-Wh...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Isn't that cute?
Amazing. Should I apply for a commercial?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you want this?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What kind of Umamusume are you...?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: This is a violatiooon of my portrait riiiights!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah, that way!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hooold oooooon!!!!

And they head forward.
Toward that stage of history and prestige—the Tenno Sho (Spring)—!
